Usage¶

Setup¶

Place airfoil_self_noise.xlsx in the data/ directory (it is not committed to the repository), then install the dependencies:

pip install pandas openpyxl matplotlib

Loading the data¶

from functions.data_loader import load_airfoil_data

df = load_airfoil_data()
print(df.head())

Adding physics features¶

Log-frequency, Strouhal number and Reynolds number are computed from the raw columns on load rather than stored in the Excel file:

from functions.data_loader import load_airfoil_data
from functions.physics_features import add_physics_features

df = add_physics_features(load_airfoil_data())

Exploratory plots¶

python src/explore_plots.py

Building these docs¶

pip install sphinx
sphinx-build -b html doc doc/_build/html
